paragraphs.text: A difficulty that should not be ignored is that team members may not be available at the same time. This matters because a task that needs several people can be delayed if their schedules do not overlap. For instance, a customer question may remain unanswered because the person with the information has already finished work. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.

requirementsVi: Phản đối việc áp dụng một cách cứng nhắc cho tất cả.
Giải thích trở ngại và khác biệt hoàn cảnh.
Thừa nhận lợi ích và đề xuất cách linh hoạt hơn.
samples.summaryVi: Đi chung xe giảm chuyến đi riêng và chia chi phí; cần phương án dự phòng khi lịch thay đổi.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: It is sometimes suggested that everyone should follow one standard approach to sharing journeys to work, regardless of their needs. I disagree with this view. A shared goal can be useful, but an identical rule may ignore the practical conditions that determine whether people can benefit from it.
paragraphs.noteVi: Phản đối sự cứng nhắc, không phủ nhận toàn bộ chủ đề.

paragraphs.label: Lý do 1 — điều kiện khác nhau
paragraphs.text: A difficulty that should not be ignored is that different schedules can make the arrangement unreliable. This matters because a late meeting or family responsibility may change one person's finishing time. For instance, a colleague may need to leave early while the driver has to stay for an unexpected task. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.
paragraphs.noteVi: Đi chung xe giảm chuyến đi riêng và chia chi phí; cần phương án dự phòng khi lịch thay đổi.

paragraphs.label: Lý do 2 — nguyên nhân cần xử lý
paragraphs.text: One reason for the difficulty is that participants may not discuss backup plans before starting. This can help explain why different schedules can make the arrangement unreliable. Consider the following situation: a colleague may need to leave early while the driver has to stay for an unexpected task. It shows that the problem is connected with the way the activity is organised, not only with an individual's attitude. Unless that underlying condition changes, asking people to try harder may have little effect.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giải thích vì sao yêu cầu cố gắng hơn chưa đủ.

paragraphs.label: Thừa nhận và hướng khác
paragraphs.text: This does not mean that the original idea has no value. For example, three colleagues living in the same area can arrange to travel together twice a week. The possibility that employees can share travel costs and reduce the number of separate trips is worth taking seriously. However, a better approach would be to agree on practical arrangements and allow flexibility. A small group could share a timetable, decide how costs are divided and keep an alternative way to travel home.
paragraphs.noteVi: Thừa nhận điểm mạnh và đưa giải pháp có điều kiện.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, I do not support requiring one method for everyone. A workable policy should keep its main purpose while allowing practical adjustments. This is more likely to help people participate than a rigid rule that treats different circumstances as if they were the same.
paragraphs.noteVi: Chốt đúng đối tượng phản đối: một phương pháp cho mọi người.

samples.title: Dịch vụ khách hàng
samples.prompt: A single standard approach to customer service training should be required for everyone, regardless of their needs. Do you agree or disagree?

samples.summaryVi: Giao tiếp lịch sự cần đi cùng quy trình và quyền xử lý để khách nhận được bước tiếp cụ thể.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: It is sometimes suggested that everyone should follow one standard approach to customer service training, regardless of their needs. I disagree with this view. A shared goal can be useful, but an identical rule may ignore the practical conditions that determine whether people can benefit from it.
paragraphs.noteVi: Phản đối sự cứng nhắc, không phủ nhận toàn bộ chủ đề.

paragraphs.label: Lý do 1 — điều kiện khác nhau
paragraphs.text: A difficulty that should not be ignored is that staff may be unable to solve problems without authority. This matters because polite language alone does not change an unclear or inflexible company process. For instance, an employee may apologise repeatedly but be unable to offer any answer about a delayed refund. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giao tiếp lịch sự cần đi cùng quy trình và quyền xử lý để khách nhận được bước tiếp cụ thể.

paragraphs.label: Lý do 2 — nguyên nhân cần xử lý
paragraphs.text: One reason for the difficulty is that businesses may train communication skills without improving internal procedures. This can help explain why staff may be unable to solve problems without authority. Consider the following situation: an employee may apologise repeatedly but be unable to offer any answer about a delayed refund. It shows that the problem is connected with the way the activity is organised, not only with an individual's attitude. Unless that underlying condition changes, asking people to try harder may have little effect.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giải thích vì sao yêu cầu cố gắng hơn chưa đủ.

paragraphs.label: Thừa nhận và hướng khác
paragraphs.text: This does not mean that the original idea has no value. For example, a shop assistant can explain the return process and tell a customer when to expect a response. The possibility that customers can understand what can be done about a problem is worth taking seriously. However, a better approach would be to give staff clear guidance and a reliable route for difficult cases. A manager could provide a simple decision guide and make sure complex complaints reach the right person.
paragraphs.noteVi: Thừa nhận điểm mạnh và đưa giải pháp có điều kiện.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, I do not support requiring one method for everyone. A workable policy should keep its main purpose while allowing practical adjustments. This is more likely to help people participate than a rigid rule that treats different circumstances as if they were the same.
paragraphs.noteVi: Chốt đúng đối tượng phản đối: một phương pháp cho mọi người.
